items.title: Animated Didone Landing Page: Blush and Dusty Pink Editorial With Multiply-Blended Product Photography
items.description: An animated, photographic LANDING PAGE in a Didone editorial register: Bodoni Moda set enormous, a Caveat Brush script accent, dusty pink #EF6F79 against plaster off-white and blush. The hero photograph sits in mix-blend-mode multiply UNDER the display type so the letterforms pass through the picture rather than over it. A second image is revealed bottom-up by a scroll-driven clip-path while the headline above it inverts in difference blend. A four-row composition breakdown advances as you scroll beside a product still. Every headline splits into per-word spans and roughly 170 elements move independently. No canvas, no animation library, all CSS custom properties. Reusable for beauty, perfume, fashion, jewellery, florist, patisserie or any boutique brand whose product photography is the argument.
items.prompt: {"summary": "A scroll-choreographed LANDING page for a boutique product house (built here as 'Orris', a natural perfumery). Bodoni Moda carries EVERYTHING, roman and italic, from 10.5px small-caps furniture at +0.18em to a poster wordmark; Caveat Brush appears three times only, always in pink, always slightly rotated, as the human mark against the Didone's formality. items.title: Animated Scroll-Printed Product Page: Warm Cream and Red Editorial With a Horizontal Card Rail
items.description: An animated, scroll-driven LANDING or PRODUCT page in a warm print register: cream #e7e2d8, ink #171717 and one hot red #ef493c, with Anton set huge and Martian Mono carrying every label at +0.18em. Five sections pin as you scroll. A poster hero whose type lifts, shrinks and fades on three separate variables. A manifesto line that fills from grey to ink through a bottom-up clip-path wipe. A horizontal rail of product cards that travels sideways as you scroll down. A pinned stage where the product's paper artifact is PRINTED in front of you, filling in its lot number, its test result and its dates before a dashed perforation opens across it. A parallax plate whose chapters swap underneath a headline. Every headline splits into per-word spans and roughly 200 elements move independently. Driven entirely by CSS custom properties written from one requestAnimationFrame-throttled scroll handler, with no animation library. Reusable for any catalogue, shop, maker, food, garden or artisan brand that ships a physical thing.

items.title: Hover reveal effect
items.description: Source: https://x.com/emilylambert/status/2005113433780617713
items.prompt:
I want to create a personal portfolio landing page for \[YOUR NAME\]. The page should be a full-screen hero section with a large headshot image \[IMAGE ONE\] as the background, centered and covering the entire viewport. My name should appear in the top left corner in a large, elegant serif font (like Playfair Display) with the first and last name stacked on separate lines. In the top right corner, add a "Portfolio" link. At the bottom right, include social media icons for Instagram, X/Twitter, YouTube, and LinkedIn that link to my profiles - use solid filled SVG icons so they're clearly visible.\
\
The main interactive feature should be a blob cursor effect that follows the mouse. When the user hovers over the page, an organic, gooey blob shape should appear and follow the cursor with a slight lag for a smooth, fluid feel. This blob should act as a "reveal" mask that shows a second version of the headshot \[IMAGE TWO\] - so as the user moves their cursor around, they're essentially revealing an alternate image underneath. The blob should have a trailing effect where smaller, fading blob shapes follow behind based on cursor speed - faster movement creates more pronounced trails. Add subtle animated wave lines in the background that respond gently to mouse movement.\
\
All text elements (my name, the Portfolio link, and the social icons) should dynamically invert to white when the blob cursor hovers over them, so they remain visible against the revealed image. The transitions should be smooth with a 300ms duration. Add a subtle parallax effect where elements shift slightly in the opposite direction of cursor movement to create depth. The overall aesthetic should be minimal and sophisticated with a white background, letting the photography and interactive elements be the focal point.

items.title: Shader: Halftone
items.description: A single ANIMATED WEBGL SHADER: Halftone, dot radius set from the field at each cell centre. The coordinate is floored to a 34-cell lattice, an fbm is sampled once at each CELL CENTRE, and that value sets the dot radius for the whole cell. It is a full-bleed fragment shader with no page around it, about 4KB, no textures, no images and no animation library, and it reacts to the pointer. Drop it behind a hero, a section or a whole page as a living background. Under prefers-reduced-motion it renders one static frame, and it falls back cleanly where WebGL is absent.

items.title: Rolodex Text
items.description: A text component that cycles through words with a 3D physical slot machine/Rolodex flip animation. Features left-aligned text for inline use and preserved 3D perspective.
items.prompt:
Create a text component that animates words changing like a physical slot machine or Rolodex. 

**Animation**: The old word should rotate 90° backward on the X-axis, while the new word flips up from the bottom. 

**Layout & Alignment**: This will be used inline (e.g., "We Deliver [Word]"). **CRITICAL**: Left-align the text within its container so it stays flush against the preceding text. 

Do not center it, or variable word lengths will create awkward gaps. 

**Technical**: Ensure the container uses preserve-3d and isn't strictly clipped, so the 3D rotation is fully visible.
